title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space To Bind Them All
layout_note: A key strip of modality icons across the top left; below it a row of real data samples, each titled with its source and the icons of the modalities it pairs; at the right a star of modality icons bound to the image icon.
grouping: A rounded grey key strip at the top; sample photos titled above; the binding diagram stands alone at the right.
shapes_depth: Coloured line icons per modality; real photos; solid vs dashed lines for natural vs emergent alignment.
proposed_highlight: The idea is the star at the right: one modality (images) at the centre of all the others.
lesson: When the figure is about data pairings, show one real sample per pairing with its modality icons, and keep the icon key in one strip at the top edge.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue CVPR 2023 (not verified in this session). Card written while studying arrangement (2026-11-15). Annotation note (2026-11-15): concept/data overview rather than an architecture diagram

arrangement.units: a row of samples, then the binding diagram at the right
arrangement.inputs_as: real photos, depth, thermal and video frames, each titled with its source

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: joint embedding of six modalities via image-paired data

insights.structure: A row of five captioned real-data tiles (Web Image-Text, Depth Sensor Data, Web Videos, Thermal Data, Egocentric Videos) leads to a hexagonal graph on the right where the image node sits at the centre connected to the other modality icons.
insights.data: Each data source is a real photograph (or stacked frames for video) with the modality icons it pairs shown beside its title; a caption 'Sheep basking in the sun' stands for text.
insights.emphasis: The binding idea is drawn in the graph: thick solid edges for naturally aligned pairs (all through images) versus thin dashed edges for emergent alignment, with an 'IMAGEBIND' label and arrow pointing at the hub.
insights.flow: Read left to right across the data tiles into the graph; the top legend band is read first.
insights.avoid: It shows no encoders or loss, so it cannot serve as a model-architecture skeleton; the photos dominate and the key result (the graph) is small at the far right.
